Performance Breakthrough: Increases ATK and DEF by 3%. This can be stacked up to 10 times and cannot be dispelled
Stress Fracture: Increases Stability damage received by 2 points, and decreases Stability damage dealt by 2 points. This is considered as a Defense type debuff
Load-Bearing Parts: Increases DEF by 30% and decreases Stability damage received by 2 points. At the end of the action, if the holder's HP is below 40%, restores HP equivalent to 50% of Bathilde's ATK. This is considered as a buff
Damage Reduction II: Reduces damage received by 20%. This is considered as a buff
Physical Summon: Summons that occupies tiles on the field and has their own attributes (e.g. Papasha's City Guard, Andoris' Auto-Turrets, Nikketa's Kulich etc)
Covering Mode: Increases Freeze damage dealt by allies towards enemies with Shield effects by 20%. Increases CRIT rate by 20% for self. Before enemies within a 8 tile radius performs an active attack, launches Interception, dealing Freeze damage equivalent to 60% ATK and 4 Stability Damage, and converts 20% of the damage dealt into Brumal Barrier for all allies. Can be triggered up to 3 times per round
Brumal Barrier: Considered a Shield. Absorption amount is equal to 200% of Alva's initial attack. When the holder deals Freeze damage, for every 1000 Shield HP held, increases damage dealt by 1.5%. When the holder receives damage, applies 1 stack of Frozen for 1 turn. This effect is treated as a Frost Barrier. This is considered as a Freeze type effect and cannot be dispelled
Liquid N2 Fang: Applies Hypothermia to all enemies within a 4 tile radius. Before enemies within range are attacked, if the enemy does not have Hoarfrost, converts a portion of its HP equivalent to 500% of Alva's ATK into Hoarfrost. This can only reduce HP to a minimum of 1, and can only trigger once per enemy per round. Only one Liquid N2 Fang can exist. When an enemy within range has its Shield broken, if the enemy is within a 8 tile radius of Alva, Alva performs an attack, dealing Freeze damage equivalent to 40% of the Shield HP
Hypothermia: Increases Freeze damage received by 20%. Considered a Freeze debuff
Hoarfrost: Considered as a special Shield. Can coexist with other Shield and will not be consumed first. When Frostloom is broken, applies Frostbite and Dismay for 2 turns
Frostbite: Increases Freeze damage received by 20%. This effect is removed upon gaining Hoarfrost. This is considered as a Freeze type effect and cannot be dispelled
Battle Prep: Exclusive effect for Alva. Can be stacked and cannot be dispelled
Wolf Eye System: If an enemy within a 8 tile radius is about to move, or before it attacks, or when it ends their action, performs an instance of Lock On Attack, dealing AoE Physical damage equivalent to 80% ATK that ignores Cover and 1 Stability to all enemies within a 3x3 tile radius of the target. This effect can be triggered once per target per round, up to a maximum of 6 times
Predation Protocol: The next active attack ignores 50% of the target's DEF, has 30% increased CRIT and 25% increased CRIT DMG. This is considered as a buff and cannot be dispelled
Frightened: When the holder is attacked by Voymastina, reduces DEF by 40%. This is considered as a debuff and cannot be dispelled
Coordinated Hunting: Increases damage dealt and CRIT by 10%. Can be stacked up to 3 times, is considered a buff and cannot be dispelled
Pursuer: Increases damage dealt by 45% and CRIT DMG by 30%. This is considered as a buff and cannot be dispelled
Hunting Rhythm: If this effect stacked up to 5 times, at the start of the next turn, triggers an instance of the passive effects of Eye of the White Mastiff. This can be triggered once per battle, and cannot be dispelled
Thermal Conduction: Uses Searing Flame as a value counter. When Searing Flame reaches 35 stacks, consumes all points of Searing Flame and applies Ember to all allied units.
Embers: Increases Burn damage dealt by 30% for 2 turns and permanently increases critical damage by 5%. Critical damage buff stacks. Considered a Burn buff. Cannot be dispelled.
Tin Soldier: When dolls with Tin Soldier assigned deals Burn damage with active skill or basic attack, Lewis commands her Tin Soldier to perform a Volley Fire at the damaged target. Each Tin Soldier can perform Volley Fire up to once per round.
Rank: The Tin Soldiers provides Lewis with additional buffs according to their Rank. (The effects of lower Ranks are included when they are of higher Ranks), this effect can be stacked. Ranks are increased by consuming Merit.
Rank 1: Lewis' Burn damage is increased by 10%.
Rank 2: Lewis' Burn damage increased by additional 15% and critical rate is increased by 10%.
Rank 3: Before Lewis launches her Ultimate skill Toy Carnival, an additional instance of Volley Fire is performed. This additional instance of Volley Fire does not increase Confectance Index nor consume Tin Soldier's Order. Grants Searing Flame.
Volley Fire: The Tin Soldier deals targeted Burn damage equal to 100% of Lewis attack and 1 Stability Damage that ignores cover. Each level of Rank increases the damage multiplier of this attack by 10%. This attack cannot be triggered by Support Attacks, Interceptions, and Counterattacks. Provides 3 points of Searing Flame and restores 1 Confectance Index to Lewis.
Merit: When the unit with Tin Soldier assigned deals Burn damage, said unit gains 1 Merit. At the end of the round, Lewis consumes 4 Merits to increase the Rank of the Tin Soldiers, maximum once per turn. This effect can be stacked up to 4 times and cannot be dispelled.
Tin Soldier's Order: When Tin Soldier performs a Volley Fire, one stack of this effect is consumed, increasing damage dealt by 30%. This effect can stack up to 6 times. Cannot be dispelled.
Aegis: If unit with Aegis takes damage within 6 tiles from Helen, she will share 100% of initial damage on their behalf
Critical Damage Up II: Increase Critical Damage by 20%. Considered a buff.
Attack Up III: Increase attack by 20%. Considered a buff.
Frost Drive: For each layer of this effect, Freeze damage dealt is increased by 20%, up to 60%. Considered a buff. Cannot be dispelled.
Overedge: For each stack of this effect possessed, critical rate and Freeze damage dealt from basic attacks is increased by 10%. This effect can be stacked, and is consumed after performing an attack. Cannot be dispelled.
Glory to Mommies: Prevents holder defense from being reduced below 100%. Cancels when holder's HP falls below 30%. Cannot be dispelled
Blade Resonance: Consumes 1 stack of this effect to increase the damage multiplier of Twin Paradise, stacking up to 3 times. Cannot be dispelled.
Laceration: When taking damage, if the attacker uses a blade attack, it deals additional damage equal to 40% of the original damage each time damage is dealt. This debuff cannot be dispelled.
Tempered Blood: Increases multiplier of next active attack by 200%
True Form: After the action ends, reverts to the state at the time this effect was gained (including all attribute values, effect stacks, and remaining durations). Cannot be dispelled.
Aichmophobia: Before taking damage, if the attacker uses a Blade to attack, that damage is increased by 30%. Consumes 1 stack after taking damage. Stacks up to 9 times. Cannot be dispelled.
Sakura Mark: When the holder takes Burn damage, consumes 1 stack of this effect, causing Sakura to deal AoE Burn damage equal to 60% ATK to the holder and all enemies within a 2-tile radius. If triggered by the Sakura Ultimate Skill Grand Isekai Adventure, consumes 3 stacks and deals AoE Burn damage equal to 180% ATK to the holder and all enemies within a 2-tile radius. Stacks up to 3. Cannot be dispelled.
Bad Luck: Increases damage taken from Sakura Mark by 10%. Considered a Burn debuff, cannot be dispelled.
Good Luck: Before performing an active attack, applies 1 stack of Sakura Mark to the target. Cannot be dispelled.
Glowing Embers: Burn damage dealt is increased by 30%, all damage dealt is increased by 15%, and the damage received is reduced by 15% for 2 turns; Critical damage is permanently increased by 5%. Critical damage buff stacks. Considered a Burn buff. Cannot be dispelled.
Hunter Type - II: Grants 8 Searing Flame points when summoned, apply Infernal Surge to all friendly units for 3 global rounds. At the end of Loreley action, a Pyro Pulse is released. Burn damage taken by all enemy units within a radius of 5 tiles around Hunter Type - II is increased by 15%.
Infernal Surge: Increases ATK by 6%. Considered a Burn type buff. Cannot be dispelled.
Pyro Pulse: Deals Aoe Burn damage equivalent to 40% ATK to all enemies within 5 tile radius, dispels 1 debuff from all allies, recovers 2 Stability points to all allies, grants 3 Searing Flame points.
Symbiotic Dance: Preventing death when taking lethal damage. If another ally dies while this effect is active, the protected unit will die in its place.
Flawless Blaze: Nullifies one instance of damage. Considered a Burn buff. Cannot be dispelled.
Movement Up III: Increases mobility by 3 tile. Considered a buff.
Alpha Process: When holder's active attack causes damage, the applicator applies a layer 1 Kill Process to random enemy targets, giving priority to the target with the fewest stacks of Kill Process. Cannot be dispelled.
Kill Process: Before using an active skill or basic attack, the applicator deals AOE Corrosion damage equal to 20% of ATK to the holder and apply a random powerful debuff for 2 turns. For each additional stack the damage coefficient is increased by 20%. Consumes all stacks when it takes effect. Can be stacked. Corrosion debuff. Cannot be dispelled.
Retrograde: The range of active skills and basic attacks is reduced by 2 tiles
Movement Down III: Mobility decreased by 3 tiles. Considered a movement debuff.
Sepal of Shyness: Increases ATK by 50% and critical rate by 20%. Summons a tent tile. Cheyanne HP becomes fixed ay 30% of the initial maximum and Defense is fixed at 0. While active, user is immune to enemy displacement skills. If an allied unit is standing on the tent tile, they cannot be targeted by enemy normal attacks and skills until leaving the tile. This buff cannot be cleansed.
Smoke: Cheyanne will not die on this tile.
Sense of Security: ATK increases by 20% (max 3 stacks). This buff cannot be cleansed.
Bullseye: When attacked by Cheyanne, DEF is reduced by 50%. Only 1 effect can be present. Defensive debuff, cannot be dispelled.
Analytical Value: When Cheyanne attacks, if the target's Analytical Value is greater than or equal to 50%, critical damage is increased by 30%, ignoring 6 points of target's Stability Index. If the Analytical Value is less than 50%, critical damage is increased by 10%, ignoring 3 points of target's Stability Index. After Cheyanne deals damage to enemy units, she consumes 30% of the target's Analytical Value.
Accumulated Preheat: For every 1 stack of this effect held, damage multiplier of ultimate skill Piercing the Clouds, Into the Sun increases by 80%. Max 3 stacks. This buff cannot be cleansed.
Cutie Pie: A summoned unit that inherits Basti’s base attributes. If enemy targets are present within a 3-tile radius upon summoning, or if enemy targets spawn, end their action, or are passively displaced into the area, Cutie Pie self-destructs within the area, dealing AoE Corrosion damage equal to 100% ATK and 2 points of Stability damage, and creating Toxic Mist tiles within the area for 2 turns. Additionally, applies Toxic Inundation and Stun to all enemy targets in the area for 2 turns, and restores HP equal to 80% ATK and 1 point of Stability Index to Basti. A maximum of 2 such summons can exist on the field at the same time.
Grudge: If the holder is within 8 tile radius around Basti before attacking, 1 layer of this effect will be consumed, and Basti will activate Special Support, dealing AoE Corrosion damage equal to 100% ATK to the holder. Can stack up to 1 layer. Considered a Corrosion debuff. Cannot be dispelled.
Sloppy Grimace: Corrosion damage taken is increased by 15%. When taking Corrosion damage, restores HP to the attacker equal to 15% of the damage dealt by that instance. Considered a Corrosion debuff. Cannot be dispelled.
Mark of Comrades: Increases damage dealt by 15%. At the end of the action restore 1 point of Stability Index. Cannot be dispelled.
Energy drink: For every 1 stack of this effect, holder and their physical summoned units deal 12% increased damage and healing done is increased by 5%, up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Considered a buff. Cannot be dispelled.
Loaded Attack: This attack damage is calculated by using 20% of max HP instead of ATK.
Coordinated Combat: After an enemy unit within 9 tile radius is hit by Liushih active attack, Point-Defense Autocannon is used against it.
Standby: Unable to attack, be targeted, and will not die. At the start of the round, recovers 30% of max HP. Cannot be dispelled
Precision: Basic attack damage multiplier is increased by 10%. Stackable. Cannot be dispelled
Lockdown: Defense is reduced by 30% when receiving damage from Liushih or enemy entity summons
Sharpness: Damage dealt is increased by 5%. Stackable. Cannot be dispelled
Blood Kiss: Sextant-specific mark. Removed upon the death of the caster. Cannot be dispelled.
Coagulation: Sextans' critical rate is increased by 5%, up to a maximum of 50%. If her critical rate exceeds 100%, the excess Critical Rate is converted into an equivalent multiplier of ATK, healing, and Critical Damage, up to a maximum conversion of 30%. Electric type buff. Cannot be dispelled.
Holy Blood Mark: Increases stability damage by 3 and allowing to ignore a 3 points of target's stability. When dealing Electric damage or melee damage, damage dealt is increased by 3% based on the number of Coagulation stacks possessed by Sextans.
Blood Emblem: Applies Scarlet Insignia to 3 enemy units within range who are already afflicted with Scarlet Insignia or are standing on Electric-attributed tiles, and deals melee Electric damage equal to 60% of attack. The damage multiplier of this effect is increased by 3% based on the number of Coagulation stacks possessed by Sextans. If this effect is triggered multiple times within a round, the damage multiplier is reduced by 20% based on the number of times damage has been dealt down to 30%.
Scarlet Insignia: Increases melee damage taken by 7%, up to a maximum of 21%. Electric debuff. Stackable. Cannot be dispelled.
Command Mode: If OTs-14 is in the Cover Order state, switch to the Demolition Order state. If OTs-14 is in the Demolition Order state, switch to the Cover Order state. Only 1 state can be active at a time.
Cover Order: Increases Critical Damage of all allied units except the OTs-14 by an amount equal to 10% of the OTs-14 initial Critical Damage. Accumulates all damage dealt by all allied units except the OTs-14. Cannot be dispelled.
Demolition Order: Increases the OTs-14 attack by an amount equal to 10% of the initial attack of all allied Dolls except the OTs-14. Accumulates all damage dealt by the user, excluding the additional Basic Attack Critical Blast. Cannot be dispelled.
Overload Pulse: Groza exclusive resource. Stores accumulated damage. Can be consumed to deal fixed damage via additional Basic Attack Critical Blast.
Reverse Assimilation: Cannot move, cannot rotate, and cannot benefit from cover; immune to Control Effects. While having Overload Pulse, can use the additional Basic Attack Critical Blast.
Cellular Reconfiguration: At the start of battle, if ally dolls of any Phase Type has majority number on the field, OTs-14 enters corresponding Phase Reconfiguration. If majority of dolls are Physical or number of phase dolls are tied, enters Reconfiguration · Zero. Only one Reconfiguration can be active at a time.
Reconfiguration · Burn: At the start of battle, gains Thermal Conduction. After using the Active skill Total Suppression, gains 13 points of Searing Flame.
Reconfiguration · Electro: Damage dealt by allied units to enemy targets under Stability Break is increased by 15%.
Reconfiguration · Freeze: When allied units deal damage, if they have shield-type effects, damage dealt is increased by 15%.
Reconfiguration · Corrosion: When an enemy unit takes damage, damage received is increased by 2% for each debuff it has.
Reconfiguration · Hydro: For each allied unit on the field, damage dealt by all allied units is increased by 2%.
Reconfiguration · Zero: While the user is under Demolition Order, attack is increased by 30%.
Doom Mark: When an enemy unit within a 9-tile radius takes targeted damage or AoE damage from allied units, performs 1 Action Support, dealing Corrosion Damage equal to 60% of attack and 1 point of stability damage, and restores 1 point of Confectance Index. Can be triggered up to 2 times per turn. Cannot be dispelled.
Focus: Critical Damage is increased by 5%, up to 30%. Stackable. Removed when mobility points are consumed. Cannot be dispelled.
First Prophecy: Resonance: Damage dealt by Action Support is increased by 50%. Before performing Action Support, Nemesis gains 1 stack of Focus. Cannot be dispelled.
Second Prophecy: Solitude: Gains 1 stack of Omen. If there are no allied units within a 4-tile radius of Nemesis, damage dealt is increased by 60%. At the start of Nemesis turn, gains 1 stack of Omen. Cannot be dispelled.
Omen: When attacked by an enemy unit, the damage taken is reduced by 80%. Stackable up to 1. Considered a buff. Cannot be dispelled.
Prophet: When attacked by an enemy unit, nullifies one instance of damage. Stackable up to 1. Considered a buff. Cannot be dispelled.
Third Prophecy: Calamity: After dealing targeted damage, if the target is not killed, deals AoE Corrosion Damage equal to 60% of attack and 1 point of stability damage to all enemy units within a 3-tile radius around it. If this effect is triggered outside Nemesis turn, it counts as Action Support. Cannot be dispelled.
Fourth Prophecy: Judgment: Gains Adjudication Privilege. Cannot be dispelled.
Adjudication Privilege: The damage multiplier of the Action Support of the Doom Mark is increased by 30%. When attacking an Elite or Boss unit, ignore 30% of target's defense, Critical Damage is increased by 35%. Considered a buff. Cannot be dispelled.
Fifth Prophecy: Startrack: Applies Stellar Insight to all allied Dolls using sniper rifles. Cannot be dispelled.
Stellar Insight: Increases the range of basic attacks and active skills by 1 tile. When dealing damage, for every 1 tile distance from the target, the damage dealt by user is increased by 5%, up to 30%. When dealing targeted damage, if distance from the target is beyond 5 tile radius, ignores Cover. Considered a buff. Cannot be dispelled.
Sixth Prophecy: Event Horizon: After dealing damage, applies Movement Denied to the target for 1 turn. Cannot be dispelled.
Feral Form: While in this state, certain skills deal Burn damage. Can switch to Hunter Form.
Hunter Form: While in this state, certain skills deal Freeze damage. Can switch to Feral Form.
Predator Mark: Soppo exclusive mark. Can stack up to 16 times. Cannot be dispelled.
Permanent Predator Mark: Soppo exclusive mark. Cannot be consumed. Cannot be dispelled.
Slaughter Trail: Before actively attacking, create Frost tiles within 2 tiles radius around the target for 2 rounds, and the damage dealt when attacking enemy units on the phaze tiles will be increased by 20%. Considered a buff, cannot be cleansed.
Berserk Factor: Increases critical damage by 5%. Can stack. Considered a buff and cannot be cleansed.
Berserk Factor I: When actively attacking an enemy target standing on an phase tile, ignores 10% of the target’s defense. For every 1 tile level, additionally ignores 10% defense. Considered a buff and cannot be cleansed.
Berserk Factor II: Based on the number of Freeze-type or Burn-type buffs on Soppo, increases Freeze damage and Burn damage dealt by 5%. Considered a buff and cannot be cleansed.
Berserk Factor III: Before dealing damage, creates Freeze tiles within a 4-tile radius around the target for 2 turns. If in Feral Form, creates Incineration tiles instead. When attacking an enemy target standing on a phase tile, damage dealt is increased by 15%; for every 1 tile level, damage dealt is further increased by 10%. Considered a buff and cannot be cleansed.
Blazing Assault I: Increases attack by 10%. Considered a Burn buff.
Frost Assault: Increases attack by 10%. Considered a Freeze buff.
Mimic Hologram: Copies the target’s skills and appearance. Counts as a Hologram.
Personal Hologram: Has its own skills and appearance. Counts as a Hologram.
Hologram: Mityl's Entity Summon, inherits her base stats. Includes Mimic Hologram and Personal Hologram.
Saturation Overflow: Increases ATK by 20%. After using the active skill Aerial Dash, creates Tideway tiles within a 5-tile-wide area along the skill path for 2 turns. After using the active skill Aerial Dash, all Holograms cast Fitting Resonance 1 time. This buff cannot be dispelled.
Fitting Resonance: Deals Hydro damage equal to 40% of ATK and 1 Stability Damage to all enemy units within 5 tile radius of self. Triggers up to 10 times per tround.
Untouchable: Damage taken is reduced by 50%. Stacks up to 3 times. Removes 1 stack when taking damage. Defence buff.
Cinematic Title: Title level increases in order. Higher-level Titles include the effects of lower-level Titles:
Mimic Rookie: Increases the Crit Rate of Mityl and Holograms by 20%. Considered a buff and cannot be cleansed.
Stunt Double: Increases Crit Damage dealt by Mityl and Holograms by 20%. Before Fitting Resonance is cast, creates Tideway tiles within its effective area for 2 turns. Considered a buff and cannot be cleansed.
Legendary Star: When Mityl or Holograms deal Hydro damage, increases damage dealt by 5% for each allied unit on the field, excluding Mityl, up to 40%. Considered a buff and cannot be cleansed.
Fitting Amplification: Damage dealt by the buff holder is increased by 15%. This effect stacks up to 6 times. Stacks are not lost when a Hologram dies.
Deductive Obsession: The healing received is increased by 15%. Damage taken is reduced by 30%. Considered a buff. Cannot be cleansed.
Detective's Immunity: When Welrod takes damage, she absorbs 70% of the final damage taken as accumulated damage value. The upper limit of absorption value is the sum of 125% of own max HP and 75% of ATK at the start of the battle (no more than 800% of own initial max HP). At the end of Welrod's action, she takes fixed damage equal to 10% of the accumulated damage. Cannot be cleansed.
Crime Backlash: Upon gaining this effect or at the end of action, takes AoE Corrosion damage from Welrod. The amount of damage is the sum of the 25% of Detective's Immunity accumulated damage value and Welrod's 15% max HP. Considered a Corrosion debuff. Cannot be dispelled.
Suspect: At the end of the turn, the debuff holder takes fixed damage equal to 8% of max HP. If they are (a) Boss unit(s), they take fixed damage equal to 180% of Welrod's ATK instead.
V3 Protection: Welrod's max HP is increased by 20%. She will not die when her HP falls to or below 15%, and will recover 30% of her max HP. Lasts 1 round. At the end of the round, cleanses all debuffs from herself and recovers 100% of max HP. Has a cooldown of 3 turns. Cannot be cleansed.
Scent Mark: Increases the damage taken from Faelynn by 15%. When this effect is applied again, it deals AoE Corrosion damage equal to 60% of applier ATK and 1 point of Stability Damage. Cannot be cleansed.
Hunter's Tracking: Corrosion damage is increased by 3%, up to maximum of 9%. Considered a buff, cannot be cleansed.
Roving Bloodlust: Faelynn's ATK is increased by 10% and stability damage dealt is increased by 1 point. Considered a buff, cannot be cleansed.
Dog-Eared Radar: When an ally unit generates tile(s) under an enemy unit within 8 tiles around Faelynn, applies Scent Mark to that enemy unit for 2 turns. Triggers up to 4 times per round. Cannot be cleansed.
Combo Pounce: Gain 1 trigger chance for Hunting Instinct. Cannot be cleansed.
Collar Brand: Faelynn's exclusive mark. Removed at the end of appliers action. Cannot be dispelled.
The Sinner: Koleda's summon. Inherits 100% of Koleda's base stats. Cannot be moved to high ground via manual control.
Upshift: Hydro damage increased by 10%, stacks up to 5 times. Considered a Hydro buff. Cannot be dispelled
D Gear: Hydro damage increased by 20%. Mobility increased by 1 tiles. Cannot be dispelled
N Gear: Cannot use KANSEI DORIFTO?! or Speedy Speed Doll! this turn. Damage taken is reduced by 100%, DEF increased by 100%. Cannot be dispelled
P Gear: Target damage and AOE damage taken is reduced by 20%. Cannot be dispelled
S Gear: Hydro damage increased by 20%, Critical Damageincreased by 20%. Mobility increased by 2 tiles. Cannot be replaced by other Gears other than S+ Gear. Cannot be dispelled
S+ Gear: Hydro damage increased by 20%, Critical damage increased by 20%. Ignores 20% of targets defence. Mobility increased by 3 tiles. Cannot be dispelled
Kinetic Recovery: ATK, Critical Damage and healing recieved increased by 10%. Considered a Hydro buff. Cannot be dispelled
Mobile Support: Damage dealt increased by 30%. Critical rate increased by 15%. Mobility increased by 1 tile. Considered a Hydro buff. Cannot be dispelled
Lets go for a spin!: Makes this Doll untargetable, disables all her skill effects and has her follow The Sinner. When The Sinner dies, Doll dies simultaneously. The Sinner gains an additional 50% of this Doll's base ATK, DEF, max HP, Stability Index, Critical Damage
Turbo Boost: ATK increased by 20%. Ignores 20% of targets defence. Considered a Hydro buff. Cannot be dispelled
Pull: Can pull the target to the units surroundings, ignoring terrain.
Immobilized: Cannot move, cannot actively shift position. Cannot a movement debuff.
Piercing I: Targeted damage ignores 20% of the target's defense. Considered a buff.
Domain Penetration I: Aoe damage ignores 20% of the target's defense. Considered a buff.
Incapaciation: Performs an attack which ends the targets movement. Cannot trigger Support Action, Interception or Counterattack.
Kinetic Release: Deals AoE Hydro damage equal to 90% of ATK to all enemy units within 3 tile radius around the unit
Kinetic Release+: Deals AoE Hydro damage equal to 120% of ATK to all enemy units within 5 tile radius around the unit
Steady: Damage taken is reduced by 30%. When Sync is applied, this effect is increased to 40%. Cannot be cleansed.
Sync: Units with Bond gain attack equal to 20% of Asteria's initial attack, up to a maximum of 600 points. Cannot be cleansed.
Vindicator's Mark: Adds all weapon weaknesses. When taking Physical damage, defense is reduced by 50% and Physical damage taken is increased by 20%. This is considered a defense debuff and cannot be cleansed.
Crime and Punishment: Critical damage and critical rate are increased by 30% and attack is increased by 50%. The unit with this buff launches Blade of Sin to the target after dealing Physical damage, to the nearest enemy unit at the end of the turn, or to the attacker after an allied unit is attacked. Each trigger method can trigger up to 1 time per turn. Before the unit with this buff takes damage, gain Shield of Punishment, triggering up to 1 time per turn. Cannot be cleansed.
Blade of Sin: Performs 1 Lock on Attack on the target, dealing melee Physical damage equal to 80% of the buff holder's attack that ignores cover reduction and 2 points of stability damage. After this attack, Asteria gains 1 point of Confectance Index.
Lock on Attack: Performs an attack. Cannot trigger Interceptions, Counterattacks, or Support Attacks.
Absolution: Physical damage taken increased by 30%. For each stack of this effect, when attacked by Asteria, critical damage taken increased by 10% and defense decreased by 10%, stacking up to 6 stacks. This debuff cannot be cleansed.
Defense Down III: Reduces defense by 40%. Considered a debuff.
Combat Stance: Comprises the stances Eagle Strike and Heavy Talons. If Eagletta is in the Eagle Strike stance, her stance is switched to Heavy Talons state upon activation, and vice versa. Only one stance can exist at a time.
Eagle Strike: Eagletta's basic attack is changed to Swift Eagle Strike, and her attack is increased by 5% of initial attack. Cannot be cleansed.
Heavy Talons: Eagletta's basic attack is changed to Rending Talons, and her mobility is increased by 2 tiles. Rending Talons and the passive skill Predation ignore 5% of the target's defense. Eagletta takes 20% less damage from targets outside of 3x3 tile area around her. At the end of the turn, Eagletta gains 1 Feather of War. Based on the number of Feathers of War consumed in the current round, the damage multiplier of Rending Talons and the passive skill Predation is increased by 5%. Cannot be cleansed.
Feathers of War: Eagletta's exclusive resource. Maximum of 7 stacks.
Queen of the Skies: The first attack on Eagletta in the current round deals 20% less damage. Range of all basic attacks is reduced to 1 tile. Considered a Freeze debuff. Cannot be dispelled.
Predation: Select 1 enemy target within a 3x3 area, dealing Melee Freeze damage equal to 60% of ATK, 1 point of stability damage and recovers HP equal to 20% of damage dealt. If the target is killed, the skills and effects that would trigger upon its death is nullified. The range of this skill cannot be modified.
Invasive Threat: ATK is increased by 5%. Maximum of 4 stacks. Considered a buff. Cannot be cleanced.
Cyclotron Potential: Before using a single target active attack, applies Conductivity for 1 turn. This effect cannot be dispelled
Preemptive Strike: When enemies within a 8 tile radius attempt to use an active attack, decreases Confectance Index by 3 points, and activates Ambush, dealing Electric damage equivalent to 80% ATK and 2 Stability damage to the target. There is a 50% chance of inflicting Conductivity before attacking for 1 turn. This effect is considered as a buff, and cannot be dispelled
